Imagine this site as a short trip with four stops—and each stop has **four sections** (sixteen sittings in all).

You begin in a garden and a kitchen—plants, processing, brewing, and the compounds in a mug. You travel inward into the body and brain. You climb out again into history, monasteries, warm hands, and ritual. You end in a lab where people play careful games about risk and trust. Each section answers a question the previous one left hanging.

Nothing here requires a science degree. Each section opens with a hook, walks you through the facts in story order, cites sources with **clickable footnotes**, tucks denser detail into **collapsed foldouts**, and leaves previous/next doors open.

## The itinerary (four hubs)

| Stop | The question that pulls you forward | Open |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. The Chemical Core | Why do two cups from the same plant taste—and feel—so different? | [Chapter 1 hub](module-01/index.qmd) |
| 2. Body, Brain & Mood | Why does tea so often feel awake *and* calmer than coffee? | [Chapter 2 hub](module-02/index.qmd) |
| 3. History, Ritual & Warmth | Is tea only chemistry—or also empire, ritual, and a warm hand? | [Chapter 3 hub](module-03/index.qmd) |
| 4. Decisions & Choices | Does the cup change how we choose—and how do researchers even measure that? | [Chapter 4 hub](module-04/index.qmd) |

## If you only have ten minutes

**"What do aisle labels mean?"**  
Start with [Tea basics](../tea-basics.qmd), then [Chapter 1 hub](module-01/index.qmd).

**"What's in my cup?"**  
Start with [Cup reference](../cup-reference.qmd), then [Chapter 1 · Section 3 · Brewing](module-01/03-brewing.qmd) and [Chapter 1 · Section 4 · Compounds](module-01/04-compounds.qmd).

**"Why awake but not jittery?"**  
Go to [Chapter 2 hub](module-02/index.qmd), then the [Linkages](../linkages.qmd#why-waiting-after-the-first-sip-matters) bridge on [L-theanine](../glossary.qmd#l-theanine) timing and calm brain waves.

**"Is tea only chemistry?"**  
No. [Chapter 3 hub](module-03/index.qmd) is the zoom-out: trade, monasteries, warm mugs, brewing breaks.

**"Do drinks change choices?"**  
[Chapter 4 hub](module-04/index.qmd)—with the caveat that lab doses are not your everyday mug.

When you are ready to begin at the beginning, open [Chapter 1](module-01/index.qmd). The water is already hot.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Click for more detail: footnotes and foldouts"}
- **Footnotes:** superscript numbers jump to the full citation; the caret jumps back. Hover often pops the note.
- **Foldouts:** boxes titled "More detail…" or "Click for more detail" stay closed until you open them—so the main story stays readable while the expansion stays one click away.
:::
